task: put the bowl on the stove

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the metal bowl on the table.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the metal bowl.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper toward its rim.
Grasp the bowl from above, closing the gripper fingers around its rim.
Grasp the bowl on the table by closing the gripper fingers around its rim.
Lift the bowl up off the table, raising it above the stove.
Carry the bowl horizontally over the table toward the stove.
Carry the bowl over the stove burner.
Release the bowl onto the stove burner and open the gripper.
Release the bowl onto the stove and retract the empty gripper upward.
Retract the open gripper upward and away from the bowl resting on the stove.
